Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started is simple. Here’s the basic flow:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump in front of your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, with the cable going over and behind the ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the intensity until you feel a light, pleasant tingling in your ear. 
Then just go about your day while it runs. You can read, work, meditate, or relax during the session. 
Typical use:
15–60 minutes per session
Daily, ideally in the morning or split between morning and evening before sleep. 
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, then gradually increase as it feels comfortable.
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.

Here’s the simple version:
Intensity (power level)
You control this yourself. Start low and increase until you feel a light tingling in your ear. It should feel comfortable, not strong. 
Session length
Usually 15–60 minutes per day. You can do it all at once or split it (e.g., morning + evening). 
When you use it
You can use it while doing normal things like reading, working, meditating, or relaxing. 
Why you use it
People often use it to support things like:
• calmness and relaxation
• better sleep
• more energy
• focus and mood balance 
So really, the only “choice” you make is:
how long you use it
when you use it
how strong the sensation feels
